guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：低雜訊偵測器讀出
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Low-noise detector readout
guides.concept: 以矽微條與 HPGe 前端為例，從 Ramo 定理與電荷靈敏積分出發，推導 ENC 的串聯、並聯與 1/f 項如何隨電容與整形時間變化，再把脈衝校正、能量解析度分解、ASIC 數位化與門檻佔用率整合成可交接的讀出系統驗證紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Using silicon-strip and HPGe front ends as examples, start from Ramo's theorem and charge-sensitive integration, derive how the series, parallel and 1/f terms of ENC scale with capacitance and shaping time, then integrate pulse calibration, resolution decomposition, ASIC digitisation and threshold occupancy into a transferable readout-validation record.
procedure: 偵測器送出的不是「到達電極的電荷」而是感應電流：依 Shockley–Ramo 定理，以速度 v 運動的電荷 q 在電極上感應的電流為 i = q·v·E_w，E_w 是把該電極設為 1 V、其餘接地時的加權場；電流對時間積分才等於訊號電荷。矽中一個最小游離粒子每微米約產生 80 個電子電洞對，300 µm 厚的感測器給出約 2.4×10⁴ 個電子，只有 3.8 fC。電荷靈敏前置放大器把這些電荷積分到回授電容 C_f 上，輸出 Q/C_f 與偵測器電容無關，前提是開迴路增益夠大。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「感測器電荷與回授電容」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

把所有雜訊折算到輸入端，以等效雜訊電荷 ENC 表示：串聯（電壓）雜訊來自輸入電晶體的通道熱雜訊 e_n² = 4kT·Γ/g_m，經輸入總電容 C 轉成電荷，隨整形時間 τ 縮短而增大；並聯（電流）雜訊來自漏電流的散粒雜訊 2qI 與回授電阻的熱雜訊 4kT/R_f，隨 τ 加長而增大；1/f 雜訊與 τ 無關，只隨 C² 成長。ENC² = F_v·e_n²·C²/τ + F_i·i_n²·τ + F_vf·A_f·C²，F 為整形器的形狀因子，CR-RC 整形的 F_v = F_i ≈ 0.92。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ENC 公式與整形時間」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

串聯雜訊由輸入電晶體的跨導與閘極電容決定：JFET 在室溫到 120 K 之間 g_m 高、1/f 雜訊低，是 HPGe 與 Si(Li) 光譜儀的傳統選擇；深次微米 CMOS 讓每通道功耗降到毫瓦等級，適合數十萬通道的 ASIC。閘極電容會加進總電容 C，若 g_m ∝ √C_gs（強反轉、固定電流密度），最佳條件是 C_gs ≈ C_d，這就是電容匹配法則。回授元件必須極低漏電與低介電吸收：C_f 用 NP0/C0G 或晶片上的金屬電容，放電路徑用 GΩ 級電阻、脈衝重置或連續的電晶體回授。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「輸入電晶體與回授網路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

從偵測器到前置放大器輸入之間的每一 pF 雜散電容都直接加進串聯雜訊：打線、保護二極體、偏壓耦合電容與 PCB 走線都要計入。偏壓透過大電阻與 AC 耦合電容送到感測器，耦合電容必須承受全偏壓且漏電極低；接地採單點或星形，讓偵測器回流電流與數位地分開，否則切換式電源與時脈的 100 kHz–10 MHz 干擾正好落在整形器通帶內。低雜訊讀出有一半是機械與佈局工程。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「偏壓網路、接地與佈局」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

校正從精密脈衝注入開始：階躍電壓 ΔV 經注入電容 C_inj 產生 Q = C_inj·ΔV，掃描 ΔV 得到增益、線性度與動態範圍；脈衝器峰的寬度只含電子雜訊，是分離雜訊來源的工具。對能譜儀而言，實測峰寬是三項的平方和：電子雜訊 FWHM_e = 2.355·ENC·ε（ε 為每對電子電洞對的能量）、統計項 FWHM_F = 2.355·√(F·E·ε)（F 為 Fano 因子）、以及電荷收集不完整項；把三項分開，才知道該改前端、偵測器還是整形。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「脈衝注入與 HPGe 能譜」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

串聯項與並聯項相等之處就是雜訊轉角，對應最佳整形時間 τ_opt = (C·e_n/i_n)·√(F_v/F_i)；轉角隨電容、漏電流與溫度移動，所以最佳 τ 不是固定值。整形時間同時決定計數率能力：一個脈衝佔用約數倍 τ，計數率 n 下的堆積機率約為 1 − exp(−n·T_p)，因此高計數率應用常犧牲 ENC 選較短的 τ，或改用梯形數位整形把雜訊濾波與彈道虧損分開處理。完整的雜訊預算要把串聯、並聯、1/f、量化與干擾各項列表後平方相加。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ENC–τ 曲線與雜訊轉角」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

現代系統把前置放大、整形、ADC 與序列化放進同一顆 ASIC：ALICE TPC 的 524,160 個墊片各有一條 SAMPA 通道，CAEN FERS-5200 一類的讀出平台則把 Citiroc 或 picoTDC 前端做成 64–128 通道的卡，經光纖集中。數位化後常以梯形濾波取代類比整形，並做基線追蹤與共模扣除；ADC 的量化雜訊 LSB/√12 必須遠小於類比 ENC，動態範圍則由滿刻度電荷與 ENC 之比決定，通常以位元數換取功耗。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ADC、數位濾波與資料鏈」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

系統層級的驗證是在完整安裝、接地與冷卻條件下重做雜訊量測，因為 ENC 在實驗室與實驗大廳常差一倍；接著用雜訊佔用率決定門檻：高斯雜訊超過門檻 k·ENC 的機率為 ½·erfc(k/√2)，乘上取樣率與通道數就是假訊號率，必須與效率要求折衷。交接文件必須含每通道的增益、ENC、門檻與遮蔽清單、溫度係數、注入電容常數與長期穩定度紀錄，讓後續校正可以追溯。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「門檻佔用率與驗收報告」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A detector does not deliver charge arriving at the electrode but an induced current: by the Shockley–Ramo theorem a charge q moving with velocity v induces i = q·v·E_w on an electrode, where E_w is the weighting field obtained by setting that electrode to 1 V and all others to ground; only the time integral of this current equals the signal charge. A minimum-ionising particle creates about 80 electron–hole pairs per micrometre of silicon, so a 300 µm sensor yields about 2.4×10⁴ electrons, only 3.8 fC. A charge-sensitive preamplifier integrates this charge onto its feedback capacitor C_f, giving an output Q/C_f that is independent of detector capacitance provided the open-loop gain is large enough. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sensor charge and feedback capacitor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

All noise is referred to the input as an equivalent noise charge (ENC): series (voltage) noise comes from the channel thermal noise of the input transistor, e_n² = 4kT·Γ/g_m, converted to charge through the total input capacitance C and growing as the shaping time τ shortens; parallel (current) noise comes from leakage-current shot noise 2qI and feedback-resistor thermal noise 4kT/R_f and grows as τ lengthens; 1/f noise is independent of τ and scales only with C². ENC² = F_v·e_n²·C²/τ + F_i·i_n²·τ + F_vf·A_f·C², where the F factors depend on the shaper, with F_v = F_i ≈ 0.92 for CR-RC shaping. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ENC relation and shaping time”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Series noise is set by the transconductance and gate capacitance of the input transistor: a JFET between room temperature and 120 K offers high g_m and low 1/f noise and remains the traditional choice for HPGe and Si(Li) spectrometers, while deep-submicron CMOS brings per-channel power down to milliwatts for ASICs with hundreds of thousands of channels. The gate capacitance adds to the total C, and if g_m ∝ √C_gs (strong inversion at fixed current density) the optimum is C_gs ≈ C_d, the capacitive-matching rule. Feedback elements must have extremely low leakage and dielectric absorption: C_f is an NP0/C0G or on-chip metal capacitor, and discharge uses a GΩ-class resistor, pulsed reset or continuous transistor feedback. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Input transistor and feedback network”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Every picofarad of stray capacitance between detector and preamplifier input adds directly to series noise: bond wires, protection diodes, bias-coupling capacitors and PCB traces all count. Bias reaches the sensor through a large resistor and an AC-coupling capacitor that must hold the full bias with negligible leakage; grounding must be single-point or star so that detector return currents stay separate from the digital ground, otherwise switching-regulator and clock interference at 100 kHz–10 MHz lands exactly inside the shaper passband. Half of low-noise readout is mechanical and layout engineering. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bias network, grounding and layout”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Calibration starts with precise pulse injection: a voltage step ΔV through an injection capacitor C_inj creates Q = C_inj·ΔV, and sweeping ΔV yields gain, linearity and dynamic range; the pulser peak width contains only electronic noise, which makes it the tool for separating noise sources. For a spectrometer the measured peak width is the quadrature sum of three terms: electronic noise FWHM_e = 2.355·ENC·ε (ε the energy per electron–hole pair), the statistical term FWHM_F = 2.355·√(F·E·ε) (F the Fano factor), and incomplete charge collection; only when the three are separated do you know whether to improve the front end, the detector or the shaping. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Pulse injection and HPGe spectrum”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The noise corner is where the series and parallel terms are equal, corresponding to the optimum shaping time τ_opt = (C·e_n/i_n)·√(F_v/F_i); the corner moves with capacitance, leakage and temperature, so the optimum τ is not a fixed number. Shaping time also sets rate capability: a pulse occupies several τ, and at count rate n the pile-up probability is about 1 − exp(−n·T_p), so high-rate applications often sacrifice ENC for shorter τ or use trapezoidal digital shaping that separates noise filtering from ballistic deficit. A complete noise budget tabulates series, parallel, 1/f, quantisation and interference terms and adds them in quadrature. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ENC–τ curve and noise corner”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Modern systems put preamplifier, shaper, ADC and serialiser on one ASIC: each of the 524,160 pads of the ALICE TPC has its own SAMPA channel, and readout platforms such as CAEN FERS-5200 integrate Citiroc or picoTDC front ends on 64–128-channel cards concentrated over optical links. After digitisation a trapezoidal filter often replaces analogue shaping, with baseline tracking and common-mode subtraction; the ADC quantisation noise LSB/√12 must stay well below the analogue ENC, and the dynamic range is the ratio of full-scale charge to ENC, usually traded against power through the bit count. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ADC, digital filtering and data links”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

System-level validation repeats the noise measurements with the full installation, grounding and cooling in place, because ENC in the lab and in the experimental hall often differ by a factor of two; the threshold is then set from noise occupancy: the probability that Gaussian noise exceeds a threshold k·ENC is ½·erfc(k/√2), and multiplied by sampling rate and channel count it gives the fake-hit rate, which must be traded against efficiency. The handoff record must include per-channel gain, ENC, threshold and masking list, temperature coefficients, injection-capacitor constants and long-term stability logs so that later calibrations remain traceable. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Threshold occupancy and acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 開迴路增益不足或回授電容選得太大時，增益開始隨偵測器電容變化，電容不同的通道增益不一致，整個系統的能量刻度跟著溫度與偏壓漂移。
注入電容的實際值與標稱差 5% 時，所有通道的能量刻度一起偏 5%，而且線性度檢查看不出來；脈衝器上升時間若比電荷收集慢，校正出的增益會低估彈道虧損。
pitfallsEn: With insufficient open-loop gain or an oversized feedback capacitor the gain starts to depend on detector capacitance, channels with different capacitance disagree, and the system energy scale drifts with temperature and bias.

If the injection capacitor differs from nominal by 5%, every channel's energy scale is off by 5% in a way linearity checks cannot reveal; if the pulser rise time is slower than charge collection, the calibrated gain underestimates ballistic deficit.

related.title: 矽像素粒子追蹤器
related.transfer: 可遷移「訊號電荷、Ramo 定理與電荷靈敏放大」與「校正脈衝、能量刻度與解析度分解」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；矽像素粒子追蹤器的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Signal charge, Ramo's theorem and charge-sensitive amplification" and "Calibration pulses, energy scale and resolution decomposition" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Silicon-pixel particle trackers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦電荷靈敏前端的 ENC、整形時間與系統雜訊預算；矽像素粒子追蹤器則以MIP 訊號、空乏與 Lorentz 偏移、輻射損傷、物質量、讀出頻寬與軌跡式對準為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on ENC, shaping time and system noise budgets for charge-sensitive front ends; Silicon-pixel particle trackers centres on MIP signal, depletion and Lorentz drift, radiation damage, material budget, readout bandwidth and track-based alignment, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「感測器電荷與回授電容」與「MIP 游離軌跡與訊號電荷」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到矽像素粒子追蹤器，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「物質量 X/X₀、多重散射與撞擊參數」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Sensor charge and feedback capacitor” and “MIP ionisation track and signal charge”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Silicon-pixel particle trackers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Material budget X/X₀, multiple scattering and impact parameter", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 科學級 CCD 成像系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「訊號電荷、Ramo 定理與電荷靈敏放大」與「校正脈衝、能量刻度與解析度分解」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；科學級 CCD 成像系統的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Signal charge, Ramo's theorem and charge-sensitive amplification" and "Calibration pulses, energy scale and resolution decomposition" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Scientific CCD imaging systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦電荷靈敏前端的 ENC、整形時間與系統雜訊預算；科學級 CCD 成像系統則以背照式量子效率、電荷轉移效率、輸出放大器讀出雜訊、深冷暗電流與光子轉移增益校正為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on ENC, shaping time and system noise budgets for charge-sensitive front ends; Scientific CCD imaging systems centres on back-illuminated QE, charge-transfer efficiency, output-amplifier read noise, deep-cooled dark current and photon-transfer gain calibration, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「感測器電荷與回授電容」與「背照式矽吸收層」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到科學級 CCD 成像系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「光子轉移曲線與 Fe-55 增益校正」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Sensor charge and feedback capacitor” and “Back-illuminated silicon absorber”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Scientific CCD imaging systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Photon transfer curve and Fe-55 gain calibration", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 低雜訊偵測器讀出
history.text: 電荷靈敏前置放大器與低雜訊讀出的理論由 1960 年代的核子電子學奠定：Radeka 在布魯克海文國家實驗室建立等效雜訊電荷與最佳濾波的分析框架，Goulding 與 Landis 在柏克萊發展脈衝整形與堆積拒絕；1980 年代起矽微條偵測器推動 CMOS 前端 ASIC（如 CERN 的 Amplex 與 Viking 系列），今日 LHC 實驗的數億通道與 HPGe 的 keV 級解析度都建立在同一套 ENC 工程上。本課只重建公開教科書層級的原理與數值方法。
history.textEn: The theory of charge-sensitive preamplifiers and low-noise readout was laid down by nuclear electronics in the 1960s: Radeka at Brookhaven National Laboratory established the equivalent-noise-charge and optimum-filter framework, while Goulding and Landis at Berkeley developed pulse shaping and pile-up rejection; from the 1980s silicon strip detectors drove CMOS front-end ASICs such as CERN's Amplex and Viking families, and today both the hundreds of millions of LHC channels and keV-class HPGe resolution rest on the same ENC engineering. This course reconstructs public textbook-level principles and numerical methods only.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「訊號電荷、Ramo 定理與電荷靈敏放大」到「系統驗證、門檻設定與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Signal charge, Ramo's theorem and charge-sensitive amplification" through "System validation, threshold setting and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
